title: POST /api/evidence/upload/ai enqueues a BullMQ file-upload job and calls the AI service in parallel via Promise.allSettled
description: uploadAI (evidence-upload.controller.js) creates the evidence draft, enqueues the 'process-upload' job on the 'file-upload' queue, and POSTs the buffered file to python-notebookAI-service's /api/v1/documents/extract-metadata-fast concurrently — neither path blocks the other.
preconditions: Logged in as a user with evidence.create
steps: POST a single PDF to /api/evidence/upload/ai with a valid project context
Inspect the BullMQ 'file-upload' queue for a new 'process-upload' job referencing the created evidenceId
Inspect the mock/stub python-notebookAI-service call log for a concurrent POST to /api/v1/documents/extract-metadata-fast?organization_id=...&project_id=...
expectedResult: Response is 201 with the new evidenceId; a file-upload job exists for that evidence; the AI service was called with organization_id and project_id query params matching the caller's org/project.

title: AI extraction failure does not block evidence creation and is recorded as a failed processingStatus
description: Because the AI call and S3 job run inside Promise.allSettled, an AI-side failure/timeout only sets aiAssistedUpload.processingStatus='failed' and aiAssistedUpload.aiSuggestions={error:true, message, statusCode, occurredAt} — the evidence draft itself is still created and the S3 upload still proceeds.
preconditions: python-notebookAI-service stubbed to return a 500 or to hang past 120000ms
steps: POST a file to /api/evidence/upload/ai while the AI service stub is forced to error
Fetch GET /api/evidence/:evidenceId once the upload settles
expectedResult: Upload still returns 201; the evidence document shows aiAssistedUpload.processingStatus='failed' with a populated error message; files[] still progresses through the normal upload worker to 'completed'.

title: confirmAI with action=send_for_review transitions draft -> submitted, then -> assigned when a valid assigneeId is supplied
preconditions: An evidence draft exists in status 'draft' from a prior AI upload
steps: Call PUT /api/evidence/upload/:evidenceId/ai/confirm with action='send_for_review' and a valid assigneeId
Fetch the evidence document and its workflow history
expectedResult: Workflow history shows draft -> submitted -> assigned as two sequential WorkflowEntry records; final status is 'assigned'.

title: confirmAI's $set deliberately excludes files and uploadStatus so it does not race the still-running upload worker
description: confirmAI's update payload intentionally omits files/uploadStatus fields, per an in-code comment, so that a confirm submitted while the S3 worker is still writing s3 keys for other files cannot clobber that write.
preconditions: An evidence draft has 3 files still 'uploading' in the file-upload queue
steps: While the 3 files are still mid-upload (status 'uploading'), call PUT /api/evidence/upload/:evidenceId/ai/confirm with a title/category change
Allow the upload worker to finish writing s3 keys for all 3 files
expectedResult: The confirm's field changes (title/category) are applied; all 3 files still end up 'completed' with their s3 keys intact — neither write clobbers the other.

title: file-upload job retries 3 times with exponential backoff starting at 5000ms before marking a file permanently failed
description: addUploadJob's defaultJobOptions: attempts=3, backoff={type:'exponential', delay:5000}. worker.on('failed') only marks the file permanently failed once job.attemptsMade >= 3.
preconditions: S3 PUT stubbed to fail on the first 2 attempts and succeed on the 3rd
steps: Enqueue a file-upload job for an evidence file
Observe attempt 1 and 2 fail against the stub, with backoff delays of ~5s then ~10s between attempts
expectedResult: The file ends 'completed' after 3 attempts; had all 3 attempts failed, the file would be marked 'failed' and the overall evidence status recomputed to 'failed'.

title: GET /api/evidence/upload/:evidenceId/upload-status reflects per-file and overall status through pending -> processing -> completed
steps: Upload 2 files via /api/evidence/upload/ai (or bulk) and immediately poll GET /upload/:evidenceId/upload-status
Continue polling until the worker completes both files
expectedResult: Early poll shows overall status 'processing' with per-file statuses among pending/uploading; final poll shows overall 'completed' with both files 'completed', matching updateOverallStatus's recomputation logic.

title: AI upload allowance exhaustion returns 402 EM_AI_UPLOADS_EXHAUSTED before any evidence document is created
preconditions: Org has already consumed its annual AI-upload allowance (e.g. 50/50 used, non-unlimited plan)
expectedResult: Request is rejected with 402 and error code EM_AI_UPLOADS_EXHAUSTED before any evidence document, S3 job, or AI service call is made — verified by asserting no new evidence document or queue job exists after the call.

title: Evidence-type-specific parse jobs (vuln/patch/sbom) are enqueued only after the confirm workflow transition fires, not before
description: confirmAI checks evidenceType and enqueues addVulnParseJob/addPatchParseJob/addSbomParseJob only after WorkflowTransitionService.transition succeeds — 'parsing is deferred until the user sends the evidence for review' per the controller comment.
steps: Call confirmAI with action='send_for_review' but force the workflow transition step to fail (e.g. invalid target state)
Inspect the vulnerability-report queue for a new job
expectedResult: No parse job is enqueued when the workflow transition fails; a parse job is enqueued only on a subsequent successful confirm call.
